ScreenProbeViewportBufferSize = ceil(SceneTextures.Config.Extent/16) = 80x56 (observed header and tile-index extents), so the scene-texture config extent is 1280x896 while the captured view rect is 1280x720. atlas_derivation.capacity_vs_actual: Actual view-driven probe grid is 80x45=3600 uniform probes; the probe-data atlas is allocated for 80x84=6720 slots (80x56 viewport buffer + 50% adaptive rows) and the adaptive data buffer capacity is 1800 entries.
